THE ECHO BELOW · SCENE
Area 20 · Rescue Nundro
Change prepared scene
Say aloud

Beyond the locked door, faded cloth hangs above a simple bed. A dwarf lies bound on the cold floor. His breathing is faint but steady.

You can take stock from the threshold before approaching what lies within. The visible condition of any person here and the space around them matter more than guessing what happened out of sight. You can offer help, ask a question, or check the way out before moving someone.

Ask the players

Who checks him, who watches the doorway, and where can you take him safely?

Choices

Escort Nundro out now, secure a rest, or continue with a stated protection plan.

If Gundren lives, arrange an actual reunion; if he died, let Nundro learn the truth from the party.
